confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are medium confidence. They rest on secondary travel-guide, aggregator and delivery-app figures from 2025-2026 that partly disagree, mostly in EUR and converted to USD at roughly 1.10 USD per EUR. Cocktail and wine rest on sparse samples: cocktail on one club average and a guide range, wine on a bar list rather than taverna pricing, so the beer relationship was used only as a sanity check. Restaurant meal anchors are medium confidence and reflect typical mid-season taverna pricing, not specific venues. Accommodation anchors are low confidence and are holistic model estimates for July peak season from general knowledge; no booking pages or current listings were inspected and no accommodation searches were run. Chania harbour-front prices run notably higher than inland side streets.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to Crete and Greek tourist-town price levels, with Chania's harbour and Old Town pricing treated as a mid-to-upper band within Crete. Accommodation is benchmarked to other mid-sized Greek and Cretan leisure towns in July peak season.
